rules.title: Relocation Assistance for No-Fault Evictions under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance and Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for a no-fault reason from RSO or JCO units must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD before serving notice, file a copy of the notice within 3 days, and pay relocation assistance within 15 days of serving notice.
rules.key_value: Eligible tenants $11,000 (under 3 years) or $14,400 (3+ years or low income); qualified tenants $23,150 or $27,400; Mom & Pop owner/family occupancy $10,550 or $21,250; JCO single-family owned by natural person one month's rent; for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027
rules.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO; tenant may raise nonpayment as an affirmative defense.
rules.status_basis: Bulletin describes existing code provisions; amounts effective July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.

exempt_if.name: resident_manager_replacement
exempt_if.text: Evicting a resident manager to replace him/her with another resident manager

exempt_if.name: natural_disaster
exempt_if.text: Required to evict due to hazardous conditions caused by a natural disaster not caused by the landlord's negligence

coverage.summary: Applies to units covered by the RSO or JCO.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempt when replacing a resident manager or evicting due to natural-disaster hazards not caused by landlord negligence.

rules.quoted_span:
All tenant not- at-fault evictions require payment of relocation assistance and the filing of a 
Declaration of Intent to Evict form with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) before 
evicting tenants from units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause 
Ordinance (JCO).

rules.title: Resident Protections Ordinance (Ordinances #188481 and #188482)
rules.requirement: Owners demolishing Protected Units for new construction must file with LAHD, give notice, and pay enhanced relocation to lower income households, with rights to remain up to 6 months, return, and first refusal.
rules.key_value: Standardized payments $115,480 (extremely low), $96,750 (very low), $87,450 (low income) for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027
rules.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.
rules.status_basis: Bulletin: adopted by City Council February 11, 2025; effective 2/11/2025.

requires.name: protected_unit
requires.text: Protected Units: units subject to rent restriction or control, or rented by lower income households within past five years, or Ellis Act withdrawn within 10 years

coverage.summary: Applies only to Protected Units demolished for new construction.

rules.quoted_span:
On February 11, 2025, the Los Angeles City Council adopted the RPO which codified and expanded upon 
replacement requirements and occupant protections of the HCA, and enhanced requirements for 
Restricted Affordable Units.  The RPO only applies to Protected Units that will be demolished for the 
purpose of new construction.
